name: Git Atomic Commits
description: Inspects git repository status, groups changes into atomic Conventional Commits, and automatically executes all commits until clean when auto_commit=true.
author: gidragir

examples.prompt: Inspect git status and generate commit commands

repo_path.description: Absolute directory path to target git repository (defaults to /data/projects/dotfiles)

auto_commit.description: If true, automatically groups and executes all commits until the repository working tree is completely clean.
